context.body: The scene interrupts Moses’ commissioned return and ends without an explanatory transition.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: At a lodging place the LORD meets “him” and seeks his death; Zipporah circumcises her son and touches the foreskin to “his feet.”
observations.label: Zipporah acts during a lethal encounter: action

observations.body: Zipporah speaks of a bridegroom of blood, and the threat is released after her action and words.
observations.label: Zipporah acts during a lethal encounter: response

observations.body: met him · sought to kill him · her son · his feet · bridegroom of blood · let him alone
observations.label: Words in Exodus 4:24–26

payload.posture: Read Exodus 4:24–26 as the lodging-place crisis evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The action is decisive while the threatened person, the feet, the addressed bridegroom, the phrase’s force, and the exact causal mechanism remain partly unstated.
payload.title: Zipporah acts during a lethal encounter
